card.name: Clock times before AM/PM
card.fires_on: Spots inside a clock time or time range where am/pm is expected next, such as after 'to' or a dash between hours, or on the last digit of a time like 4:30. Seen in opening hours, event times and timestamps.

modes.label: Range link
modes.description: The 'to' or dash joining two times in an hours range.

modes.label: Digits of a time
modes.description: A digit inside a clock time just before the am/pm or o'clock marker.

modes.label: Space after AM
modes.description: The gap after a time and before 'to' or the second time in an hours range.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward am/pm, noon, midnight and clock words as the next text.
card.plain: It marks the spot in a time of day or hours range where am or pm is about to come.
